description: Nordic food system circularity loops — existing operational loops and identified gaps

existing_loops.name: Biogass fra matavfall (Danmark)
existing_loops.flow: Food waste + manure → anaerobic digestion → biogas + digestate → energy + fertilizer → agriculture
existing_loops.policy_support: 20-year subsidy regime, mandatory food waste sorting 2024

existing_loops.name: Panteordning (Norge)
existing_loops.flow: Consumers → return machines → Infinitum → recyclers → new bottles/cans

existing_loops.name: Fiskeavfall til fiskemel/olje (Norge)
existing_loops.flow: Fish heads/bones/organs → rendering → fishmeal + fish oil → feed/supplements

existing_loops.name: TINE myse til protein (Norge)
existing_loops.flow: Cheese production whey → protein isolation → premium whey protein products

existing_loops.name: Matsentralen redistribusjon (Norge)
existing_loops.flow: Surplus food from retail/industry → food banks → vulnerable populations

existing_loops.name: Too Good To Go (Norden)
existing_loops.flow: Surplus food from restaurants/stores → discounted magic bags → consumers via app

existing_loops.name: REKO-ringer direktesalg (Finland/Sverige/Norge)
existing_loops.flow: Local producers → Facebook groups → consumers pick up at designated spots

existing_loops.name: Den Magiske Fabrikken (Norge)
existing_loops.flow: Food waste + manure → co-digestion → biogas (vehicle fuel) + digestate (fertilizer)

existing_loops.name: Nortura biprodukter til for (Norge)
existing_loops.flow: Slaughter byproducts → rendering → animal feed/pet food

existing_loops.name: Gratis skolemat (Finland/Sverige)
existing_loops.flow: Public procurement → school kitchens → universal free meals (since 1946 FI / 1948 SE)

existing_loops.name: Kalundborg industriell symbiose (Danmark)
existing_loops.volume: World's first industrial symbiosis, includes food processing
existing_loops.flow: Waste heat/water/materials exchanged between co-located industries incl. food

existing_loops.name: Gasum tverrnordisk biogass (Finland/Sverige/Norge)
existing_loops.volume: Cross-Nordic operator, LBG trading DK/SE → NO
existing_loops.flow: Biogas production in FI/SE → LBG transport → heavy vehicle fuel across Nordics

existing_loops.name: Biogass (Sverige)
existing_loops.flow: Food waste + manure → biogas + digestate → vehicle fuel + fertilizer
existing_loops.policy_support: Tax incentives, mandatory sorting from Jan 2024

existing_loops.name: Grønt Punkt EPR emballasje (Norge)
existing_loops.flow: Producers pay EPR fee → Grønt Punkt → collection/sorting → material recycling

gaps.name: Matsentralen kapasitetsgap
gaps.potential_volume: Only 3% of industry surplus redistributed. Can 3x to 15-20,000t/year

gaps.name: Biogass kapasitetsgap Norge vs Danmark
gaps.potential_volume: 10x gap: NO 470 GWh vs DK 8,100 GWh. Norwegian potential: 5,500-11,000 GWh

gaps.name: Insektprotein til for
gaps.potential_volume: BSF: 1t food waste → 200kg protein. EU-approved for 7 species
gaps.barrier: Price gap vs soy, scaling capital. Enorm Biofactory (DK) went bankrupt Oct 2025

gaps.name: Alge/tangdyrking kommersiell
gaps.policy_lever: Aquaculture permits for seaweed, R&D funding

gaps.name: Oppdrettsslam valorisering
gaps.potential_volume: Fertilizer, biochar, biogas from fish farm sludge
gaps.barrier: Technology choice: drying vs pyrolysis vs AD
gaps.policy_lever: Closed containment regulation capturing more sludge

gaps.name: Husholdningsmatsvinn stagnering
gaps.potential_volume: Only -5% reduction vs -21% retail (NO). 215,000t household waste
gaps.policy_lever: EU WFD 30% reduction target. Date labeling reform

gaps.name: HORECA reuse/sirkularitet
gaps.potential_volume: EU PPWR target: 10% takeaway in reusable by 2030. ~150,000 containers needed (NO)

gaps.name: Regenerativ landbruksomstilling
gaps.barrier: Investment risk for farmers, lack of long-term support
gaps.policy_lever: DK CO2-avgift creates incentive. CAP reform

gaps.name: Akademia→industri kobling
gaps.potential_volume: 71 master theses + 11 PhDs indexed. Little commercialized
gaps.barrier: Feed companies won't adopt alternatives until price-competitive with soy
gaps.comparable_solution: Enifer (FI) and Solar Foods (FI) rare success stories

success.name: Too Good To Go
success.concept: Surplus food app — discounted 'magic bags' from restaurants/stores
success.status: 120M users globally, 8.1M meals saved H1 2025, 67% growth
success.lesson: Platform/discount models scale. Low fixed costs + network effects

success.name: Solar Foods (Solein)
success.concept: Protein from CO2 + electricity via gas fermentation
success.lesson: Deep-tech can scale with patient capital + regulatory fast-track (Singapore)

success.name: Den Magiske Fabrikken
success.concept: Co-digestion of food waste + manure for biogas + fertilizer
success.lesson: Public-private partnership + waste infrastructure integration works

success.name: REKO-ringer
success.concept: Facebook-based direct sale from local producers to consumers
success.lesson: Zero infrastructure costs (Facebook groups). Grassroots scales when friction is minimal

success.name: Gasum
success.concept: Cross-Nordic biogas production and LBG distribution
success.status: Operating plants in FI, SE, NO. Cross-border LBG trade
success.lesson: Nordic interoperability in energy infrastructure enables scale

failure.name: Restaurant Rest
failure.concept: Zero-waste gourmet restaurant (8 tables), Michelin Green Star
failure.cause: COVID aftermath + energy crisis + cost inflation. Part of wave (41 restaurant bankruptcies Sept 2024)
failure.lesson: Premium/fine dining + circularity = economically fragile. High fixed costs cannot absorb macro shocks

failure.name: Enorm Biofactory
failure.concept: Large-scale insect protein (22,000 m2), BSF from food waste, Arla partnership
failure.cause: Price gap vs soy too large. Scale-up costs exceeded revenues. Even industrial partner (Arla) not enough
failure.lesson: Production-heavy circularity needs price parity with incumbents. Subsidies or regulation needed to bridge gap

actor_cases.pattern: Platform/discount models (TGTG, REKO, Holdbart) survive under cost pressure. Production and premium models (Rest, Enorm, Ÿnsect) collapse. Key factor: fixed cost structure and price gap vs incumbents. Insect meal costs 2-10x more than soy/fish meal. Critical insight for pilot recommendations.

additional_success.name: Volare
additional_success.concept: Insect protein from industrial food waste (BSF). Circular upcycling of residual streams into protein, oil, fertilizer
additional_success.lesson: Finnish insect companies surviving where Danish/French fail — possibly leaner cost structure

additional_success.name: Finnforel
additional_success.concept: Recirculating aquaculture system (RAS). 3,000t rainbow trout/year. Two operational facilities
additional_success.status: Raised $259.8M Series A (Oct 2024). Largest agrifoodtech raise in Finland
additional_success.lesson: Closed-loop aquaculture at scale attracts massive capital. Captures all waste for valorization

additional_success.name: Melta
additional_success.concept: Bokashi fermentation of food waste → organic fertilizer. Retains 90% of material vs 40-60% traditional composting
additional_success.status: Won Nordic Circular Hotspot Award. Partnership with Kronán supermarket. Created Moldamín product from expired produce
additional_success.lesson: Low-tech circular solution for rural communities. Reduces collection costs 70%. Fights Iceland's soil erosion

additional_failure.name: Ÿnsect
additional_failure.concept: World's largest insect protein producer (mealworm). Vertical integration from breeding to processing
additional_failure.cause: Insect meal 2-10x more expensive than fish/soy meal. Regulatory barriers on using organic waste as feedstock. Variable waste composition = slower growth/higher mortality. $600M+ burned without reaching profitability
additional_failure.lesson: Even with massive capital, novel protein production cannot compete on price alone. Regulatory framework must change for waste-as-feedstock to work

nordic_agrifoodtech_funding_2024.notes: Finland ahead of Japan, Canada, Brazil in agrifoodtech VC
